chiaki_quotes: Cuz... we should never forgive that. Killing... is something we should never forgive.
It's not a game if you're not having fun. It doesn't mean anything if you just focus on winning or losing.
Moving forward, we should put aside all unnecessary preconceptions and just choose the answer... I think.
If you want to believe in someone... you need to overcome doubt first. Belief without doubt... is simply a lie.
It's fine if you don't know. What matters is that you hold on to the feeling that you have to do your best.
It's true we've been constantly betrayed...But even if I'm betrayed again, I still want to believe in everyone. No matter how many times I may be betrayed...I still want to believe in everyone.
As long as everyone continues to move forward toward the future we created together... I will never disappear. What I lived for, fought for, and risked my life for will still exist.
Despite their clumsiness, I'm sure whoever made this probably did their very best... If you look at it carefully...don't you feel like you can sense their feelings?
It doesn't make a difference whether you have a talent or not. I mean, that isn't the end goal.
By getting involved with others and making memories, hope, which is more important than talent, is born. I have fun playing with you... I think.
Killing is wrong, no matter what!
I'm Chiaki Nanami, the Ultimate Gamer. Video games are my hobby, and I'm a fan of all genres...Nice to meet you.
...Don't ever forget about me...even after you get out of here.
Killing...I'll never allow it.
I'll be cheering for you guys from now on... from somewhere.
I'll...never forget about you guys. I'll never...ever forget...
I'll...be cheering for you, too...
That's why you can't hesitate now. Resolve to throw everything away and give it everything you got.
Even if it's a convenient miracle...If you just do it, things will turn out okay.
If you guys carried the burden of both hope and despair, you should even be able to create the future.
No matter what kind of future it is... As long as you guys move toward it, I will never disappear.
Now then... It's about time you show me your cool side, Hajime.
This isn't for the sake of anyone else. You...You have to do this for yourself.
I guess what I'm trying to say is... if you just do it, things will turn out okay.
You guys don't have to just choose a future... you should be able to create one as well.
But if you can't choose either future... why don't you just create one?
You guys are the only ones... who have the right to decide your future. And the responsibility too.
So it's going to be alright. I think it's time you finally had confidence in yourself.
If you can't do that... No matter how much talent you possess, you will never be confident in yourself.
What's important is that you believe in yourself.
There's something much more important than whether or not you have talent, right?
Having talent isn't the goal.
Didn't you want to become someone with confidence? Isn't that why you admired Hope's Peak Academy?
How much longer are you going to be this indecisive?!
Not just of disappearing... You're scared of moving toward the future with such a heavy burden, right?
You're... probably just scared, right?
What I lived for, fought for, and risked my life for will still exist.
But still, I want to protect everyone by any means.
And... I'm happy that I'm able to do that.
Unlike before, you guys don't have to stay alive by doubting someone...you guys can stay alive by believing in me.
Hajime... you're going to listen to my request, right?
I want you to do it. I believe you can prove it.
Maybe... I wanted to protect everyone, no matter the cost.
I won't lose. I won't let you beat me! My classmates, Instructor Yukizome, and I will definitely stop you!
